text: Hair transplantation is a surgical procedure in which hair follicles from the donor area (usually the back of the head) are transplanted to areas where hair has already been lost.
Many are disappointed after a transplant – either due to poor results or unrealistic expectations. There is, however, a solution that can complement everything: SMP micropigmentation.

sections.title: Scalp Micropigmentation (Hair Tattoo) – Visual Trick for Fuller Hair
bullets: Works excellently on thinning hair – scalp micropigmentation
Complements hair transplant results
Covers scars from FUE/FUT techniques
Results last 2–4 years without surgery or recovery
Scalp tattooing is an effective pigmentation method
text: Scalp micropigmentation (hair tattoo) is a non-invasive pigmentation procedure where pigments create a shading effect that mimics thicker hair. Up close, it appears as micro-dots; from a distance – an illusion of depth that reduces contrast between skin and hair.

sections.title: Important: SMP Has Its Limits
text: Scalp micropigmentation is a two-dimensional solution – it works visually, not physically. It does not add actual volume but creates the optical illusion of a denser hairline.

If you have larger completely bald areas, a hair tattoo cannot create the appearance of a lush, three-dimensional hairstyle. However, SMP can significantly improve the visual look, reduce contrast, and elegantly bridge transitions between hair-covered and bald areas.
